current_status.summary: FieldOps Lab has a local web application, read-only HTTP API, static platform contracts, tested reports, and quality gates. This contract defines the deployment path but does not perform deployment.
current_status.reason_not_live_yet: Cloud project configuration, Firebase Hosting target, Cloud Run service definition, environment variables, deployment scripts, smoke tests, and production safety gates still need to be added and validated.
current_status.honesty_note: Passing local tests means the repository is internally consistent. It does not mean the site is already hosted, reachable by users, or connected to a production backend.

frontend.responsibility: Serve the FieldOps Lab web interface and read-only research/diagnostic views.
must_not_do: mutate backend state without an explicit safe API
claim that static samples are real experiment results

api.responsibility: Expose read-only project status, reports, platform contracts, solver integration plans, comparative analysis contracts, and static samples.
must_not_do_now: execute optimization jobs directly from public browser requests
write experiment outputs without job IDs and audit trail

expected_platform_options: Cloud Run service with authenticated job queue
local controlled execution during research phase

storage.future_experiment_outputs: Cloud Storage or Firestore, not browser local state

deployment_targets.purpose: Development, testing, quality gate validation, and local demonstrations.

required_before_deploy: hosting public directory points to apps/web/dist or equivalent build output
SPA rewrite policy if React routing is used

deployment_targets.purpose: Host the read-only FieldOps Lab API.
required_before_deploy: port binding through environment variable or platform-compatible port

deployment_targets.purpose: Run solver-backed experiments and policy comparisons.
blocked_until: resource and cost controls are explicit

required_environment_variables.name: FIELDOPS_API_BASE_URL
required_environment_variables.description: Base URL used by the web app to read the deployed API.

required_environment_variables.name: PORT
required_environment_variables.description: Port provided by Cloud Run and used by the API server.

required_environment_variables.name: FIELDOPS_RUNTIME_MODE
required_environment_variables.description: Runtime mode such as local, staging, or production.

deployment_smoke_tests_required: POST to read-only endpoints remains blocked

research_alignment.system_goal: Provide a web-based experimental platform for dynamic TRSP/WSRP field operations.
research_alignment.dissertation_focus: Delay propagation and comparative evaluation of re-planning policies.
research_alignment.deployment_role_in_research: Deployment is useful for demonstration, reproducibility, advisor review, and future company validation, but the academic contribution remains the experimental method and decision framework.

forbidden_current_behaviors: silent file writes from web requests
claims that static samples are real experiment results

next_implementation_steps.title: Expose deployment readiness through the read-only API
Render deployment readiness and solver/comparative status in the web UI
Add Cloud Run API container configuration

conservative_note: This contract intentionally separates local correctness, deployment readiness, and real runtime execution. The project is progressing, but the deployed site and production solver-backed experiment engine should not be claimed until deployment configuration, smoke tests, authentication decisions, and execution controls exist.
